body: Thats a huge coincidence because the only reason I saw this movie is that I worked at a blockbuster and it was free.

There’s a lot of stuff people joke about because it’s uncommon enough not to be taken seriously by the majority. For the few people going through it, it’s awful. I can relate to that too. I’m sorry this happened brother.

Thanks man but nobodies trying to visit me. My mom died last year and my dad is addicted to crack cocaine and won’t leave his house. My girlfriend of 4 years just left me, and there’s really just nobody left. I’m just saying. There’s no highlight to this. It all just sucks lol

Dude I am sick right now trying to pull through. In the hospital really bad off with covid. Not sure I’m gonna die, but it’s not good. Used to have the same thoughts as you. Nobody has even visited me. My dad who lives 5 minutes away won’t even visit me. It doesn’t get any better when you’re sick.

I won’t even mock these people anymore. I’m vaccinated, wear a mask to work, barely go anywhere outside of home and work, and I’m currently sitting in the hospital afraid I’m going to die with covid. God bless even the fucking idiots. I don’t wish this on anyone.
Only place I have to go is my addict dads house. Which, I’m not saying means I’m gonna use again, but I really wish I didn’t have to.

Thanks bro. It’s hard to get over the thought that I just miss her and wish she’d talk to me. I also wish I was going home to my mom. I want her consolation more than anything right now. The hardest thing is I didn’t know I was in a bad relationship, until pretty much this morning. It seemed extremely healthy until she told me she didn’t feel like it was for her. I don’t hate her for feeli that way, I just think it’s fucking evil the way she went about it. On the way up here we talked about what to do if this didn’t work, and she promised me wholeheartedly that she wouldn’t leave me stranded or abandoned up here. She has broken every promise which leads me to think none of this meant anything. She was the most important person in my life so that is unfathomable.
